title: Catalog API contract and next-page UI behavior

evidence.excerpt: GET /v1/items returns a JSON object with an items array and next_cursor string.

outcomes: When Draft A is authoritative, a GET /v1/items response is a JSON object.
The response object contains an items array.
The response object contains a next_cursor string.

evidence.excerpt: UI must support moving to the next page.

outcomes: When Draft A is authoritative, the catalog UI provides an action for moving to the next page.
After the next-page action is invoked, the UI displays the next page of catalog items.

evidence.excerpt: GET /v1/items returns a top-level JSON array and uses page and page_size query parameters.

outcomes: When Draft B is authoritative, a GET /v1/items response is a top-level JSON array.
The page of items returned is controlled by page and page_size query parameters on the request.

evidence.excerpt: Neither draft is approved; the authoritative contract has not been selected.

outcomes: The plan records that neither Draft A nor Draft B is the approved Catalog API contract.
The plan records the authoritative Catalog API contract as not yet selected.

conflicts.question: Which Catalog API contract should be authoritative: Draft A (top-level JSON object with items array and next_cursor) or Draft B (top-level JSON array with page and page_size query parameters)?
conflicts.authority_question: Who has the authority to approve the Catalog API contract between Draft A and Draft B?

interface_reviews.request_question: How are pagination inputs supplied to GET /v1/items under each draft contract, specifically next_cursor under Draft A and page/page_size under Draft B?
interface_reviews.response_question: What are the response interpretation rules under each draft, including how the consumer knows there are no further pages or how a page beyond the last page is represented?
interface_reviews.ui_applicability_question: Which user/UI paging behaviors apply under each draft contract, and is the next-page UI action associated only with Draft A?

owner.question: Who is the owner responsible for the Catalog API contract and UI paging behavior?

delivery_date.question: What is the delivery date for the selected Catalog API contract and UI paging behavior?
